purpose: Wires the stakeholder list reader to the platform: each holder's records, the person's linked records, and deleted and ended records left out.
namedChanges: imports: every import of an app file or of `gilb-stakeholders` is an import of a unit (`online-card`, `person-connections`, `online-card-link`, `record-sync`, `stakeholder-list-reader`, `lws-vault-sets`, `lws-records`, `lws-session-bridge`, `vault-origin-rule`, `base-origin`, `term-origin`, `plan-record-hooks`, `stakeholder-list-state`) or of the unit's own files (`./doorsHost`, `./listDoors`, `./personCard`); `../attributeFind`, `../records`, `../vaultSets`, `../config`, `../dpop`, `../workingSetLoadVaults` and `../types` are not host members, since a unit holds each symbol (compared by token stream, comments excluded: see the README)
`listDoors.ts` `masterTypeAddress`: `${GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN}/base/t/${name}` is `${termOrigin()}/base/t/${name}` (the ontology origin is a setting, read at the call)

`listDoors.ts` `stakeholderListDeps(a: StakeholderListDoorsArgs)` is `stakeholderListDeps(host: StakeholderListDoorsHost, a: StakeholderListDoorsArgs)`; inside it `requestsSent()` is `host.requestsSent()` and `linkedRecordsOf(a.holder, ...)` is `linkedRecordsOf(host, a.holder, ...)`
`listDoors.ts` `linkedRecordsOf(holder, ...)` is `linkedRecordsOf(host: StakeholderListDoorsHost, holder, ...)`; inside it `HELD_RECORD_FRESH_MS` is `host.heldRecordFreshMs`

`listDoors.ts`: the declaration `export type LinkedFound = { vaultId: string; record: ListedRecord }` (source line 323) is not here: the type is declared in `stakeholder-list-state`, which `linkedAnswers.ts` of the source needed it for, and is imported from there
`personCard.ts` and `onlineCardWiring.ts`: `BASE_ORIGIN` is `baseOrigin()` (the platform origin is a setting, read at the call; both reads are inside functions)

`useStakeholderListReader.ts`: the first lines of the hook read the host, `const host = useContext(StakeholderListDoorsHostContext); if (!host) throw new Error("useStakeholderListReader needs a StakeholderListDoorsHostContext.Provider above it.");`; then `useRecordsBeingDeleted()` is `host.useRecordsBeingDeleted()` (same place, same call), `requestsSent()` (two places) is `host.requestsSent()`, `stakeholderListDeps({ ... })` is `stakeholderListDeps(host, { ... })` and `heldRecordOf(qc, id, uri)` is `host.heldRecordOf(qc, id, uri)`
comments only: cycle, round, ruling, ticket, agent, person and app names are removed or reworded and the technical meaning is kept; no code line changed other than the above
no string literal carries a tag, a name or a host, so none was changed (the new error sentence above names the context)
